# The Legal Times reports on Burford’s entry into Korea


January 22, 2026


-
-
-
-


**The Legal Times** covers Burford's expansion into Korea, including the appointment of[Elizabeth Shin](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/elizabeth-shin/) as Senior Vice President and Head of Korea. The article discusses the rising demand for sophisticated dispute finance in Korea as Korean companies command a more prominent role in global disputes.


Read the article, published in Korean,[here](https://www.legaltimes.co.kr/news/articleView.html?idxno=91758) .
